symbols.name: control chunk
symbols.meaning: The address chunk whose selected bits are XORed into the target chunk $W$.
symbols.quote: Let $X$ and $W$ be two disjoint address chunks, that is, contiguous groups of address bits, of equal width $L$, and let $T$ be a third chunk, whose initial value is arbitrary.

symbols.name: target chunk
symbols.meaning: The address chunk whose selected bits receive the XOR and are updated by the procedure.
symbols.quote: Let $X$ and $W$ be two disjoint address chunks, that is, contiguous groups of address bits, of equal width $L$, and let $T$ be a third chunk, whose initial value is arbitrary.

symbols.name: scratch chunk
symbols.meaning: The third address chunk, whose initial value is arbitrary and which is used as temporary space.
symbols.quote: Let $X$ and $W$ be two disjoint address chunks, that is, contiguous groups of address bits, of equal width $L$, and let $T$ be a third chunk, whose initial value is arbitrary.

symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The number of address bits in each of the chunks $X$ and $W$.
symbols.quote: Let $X$ and $W$ be two disjoint address chunks, that is, contiguous groups of address bits, of equal width $L$, and let $T$ be a third chunk, whose initial value is arbitrary.

symbols.name: segments per chunk
symbols.meaning: The number of $K$-bit segments into which each chunk is cut, so that each segment holds one selected bit.
symbols.quote: Each chunk is cut into $f$ segments of $K$ bits, so $L = fK$.

symbols.name: segment width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each segment of a chunk.
symbols.quote: Each chunk is cut into $f$ segments of $K$ bits, so $L = fK$.

symbols.name: first selected position
symbols.meaning: The position of the first selected bit, counted from $0$ at the least significant end.
symbols.quote: Let $\rho$ be the position of the first selected bit, counting positions from $0$ at the least significant end.

symbols.name: exceptional addresses
symbols.meaning: The set of addresses at which the parallel segment updates may carry, and which the correction handles.
symbols.quote: Let $E$ be the set of addresses for which some guard lies outside the range from $10$ to $2^{K-1}-11$.

symbols.name: interchange exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed exponent, between $0$ and $1$, in the time bound of the address-field interchange.
symbols.quote: The movement costs $O(V(L^\tau+1))$, where $\tau$ is the fixed exponent of the [Address-field interchange](address-interchange.md) and $V$ is the number of bits in the stream.

symbols.name: stream volume
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in the stream on which the procedure runs.
symbols.quote: The movement costs $O(V(L^\tau+1))$, where $\tau$ is the fixed exponent of the [Address-field interchange](address-interchange.md) and $V$ is the number of bits in the stream.

relations.predicate: supplies the binary basis changes of
relations.quote: Packed selected-bit addition supplies the binary basis changes of the [Simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md).
Packed selected-bit addition exchanges its chunks by the [Address-field interchange](address-interchange.md) whenever a target chunk must be moved beside its controls.
Packed selected-bit addition shifts its target chunks by controlled offsets, each applied as an [Address shear](address-shear.md).
